en.tools.title: Journey tools
en.journey.confirmRestart: Reset all journey progress? The journey will restart paused.

en.journey.restored: Saved progress restored. Resume when ready.
en.position.title: Position
en.position.help: Manual position is fixed, not live GPS. Update it or confirm arrival as you move.

en.diagnostics.compassWaiting: Compass: waiting for a fresh absolute reading.
en.diagnostics.compassUnavailable: Compass: unavailable or permission not granted.
